icon.prompt: Design the app icon for a mobile idle clicker game called Stackyard, about running a container port. Square, full-bleed artwork filling the whole canvas edge to edge (the store rounds the corners itself), no border, no text, no letters. One bold centered emblem: a big red ship-to-shore gantry crane lifting a bright orange shipping container over a short stack of colourful containers, teal sea with a white wake at the bottom, warm sunset gradient sky behind with a soft glow. Chunky crisp pixel art in the style of the reference screenshots, thick dark outlines, high contrast, simple silhouette that still reads at 48 pixels, cheerful and inviting.

keyart_square.prompt: Match the reference screenshots exactly: the same crisp top-down pixel art, the same palette (teal and navy sea with pixel ripple strokes, warm grey asphalt, beige concrete quay with crane rails, red ship-to-shore gantry cranes, teal yard gantries, colourful shipping containers), hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no photorealism. Do not draw any text, letters, numbers, logos, UI or HUD. A square key art of the same container port at blue hour, floodlights and string lights coming on over the yard, a container ship moored at the quay with cranes lit up, reflections and white foam on the dark teal water, cozy and inviting. Leave the top quarter as calm sky-lit water for a title.

keyart_wide.prompt: Match the reference screenshots exactly: the same crisp top-down pixel art, the same palette (teal and navy sea with pixel ripple strokes, warm grey asphalt, beige concrete quay with crane rails, red ship-to-shore gantry cranes, teal yard gantries, colourful shipping containers), hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no photorealism. Do not draw any text, letters, numbers, logos, UI or HUD. A wide cinematic key art of a busy Brazilian container terminal seen from above at golden hour: a big container ship arriving up the channel leaving a long white V-shaped wake on the water, a second ship moored at the quay being worked by three red gantry cranes, containers swinging in the air, tall colourful stacks in the yard, little trucks and a tug boat, warm sunset light with long soft shadows. Leave calm open sea on the left third of the picture for a title.

logo.prompt: Design the game logo for a mobile idle clicker game. It must read exactly STACKYARD in one line, spelled S-T-A-C-K-Y-A-R-D. Each big chunky letter is built like a pixel-art shipping container block in a different colour (orange, teal, red, yellow, blue), with corrugation lines, thick dark outline, slight 3D depth and a hard drop shadow, like a stacked container yard. A small red gantry crane hook hangs over the letter A. Under the word, a smaller navy ribbon reading exactly IDLE PORT TYCOON in clean bold pixel letters. Crisp pixel art in the palette of the reference screenshot. Place it on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta background (#FF00FF) with nothing else, no scenery, so it can be cut out.
